technical-summary: Owner-side calibration ingest watcher, off by default: the session watches helper 0's log for the single RHP16_CALIBRATION_JSON line and stores it through the ingest primitive with provenance from its own running manifest. The primitive is split from the lab-manifest checks (live_policy_target_from_manifest), a complete row may replace only a partial one, and a store failure is a warning, never a serving failure. No start enables it yet.
